note: MEDIA lane for the Star Buds shop redesign pitch ("Pop Glass"). Illustrative industry imagery added by the redesign. Every file is AI-generated and labelled (IPTC trainedAlgorithmicMedia); none depicts Star Buds, its stores, staff, customers, products or brands. Cut-outs (transparent PNG) are the front plane that breaks out of glass panels and section edges.

defaults.style: sharp focus, vivid clean colour, no people, no hands, no faces, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no brand marks, all surfaces blank and unmarked
